items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra, signaling a leap in the next-gen language model family. The announcement hints at expanded reasoning, safety controls, and deployment options aimed at enterprise-scale AI workloads. For developers and researchers, Astra's release could shift expectations around performance and compliance in AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Astra，标志着下一代语言模型的跃进。公告暗示在推理能力、安全控制和面向企业的部署选项方面的改进，可能改变开发者对性能与合规性的预期。对于开发者和研究者而言，这一发布将影响 AI 工具的性能与合规性基线。

items.title_en: .name Termination
items.title_zh: .name 域名将终止
items.summary_en: The .name top-level domain is being terminated, removing a way for individuals to register name-based identities online.
items.summary_zh: .name 域名将终止，个人以姓名注册的域名途径将消失。

items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B available on Cerebras at 1500 tokens/s
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 可在 Cerebras 上以每秒 1500 tokens 的速度运行
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8 27B is now accessible on Cerebras hardware, achieving around 1500 tokens per second. This demonstrates the viability of running large LLMs on specialized accelerators with high throughput, potentially lowering latency for edge-like deployments. As hardware-optimized models become easier to run, developers may push more real-time AI features into apps and services.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 已在 Cerebras 硬件上可用，吞吐约每秒 1500 token，显示了在专用加速器上高吞吐运行大模型的可行性，或降低对接近边缘部署的延迟。随着对硬件优化模型的可用性提升，开发者有望在应用和服务中引入更多实时 AI 功能。

items.title_en: Audacity 4.0
items.title_zh: Audacity 4.0 发布
items.summary_en: Audacity 4.0 marks a major milestone for the popular open-source audio editor. It focuses on stability and ongoing maintenance, with improvements to performance and compatibility for modern formats and plugins.
items.summary_zh: Audacity 4.0 是这个开源音频编辑器的最新重大版本。它聚焦稳定性与持续维护，带来性能优化和对现代音频格式及插件的兼容性改进。

items.title_en: Grep beats LSP? Why coding agents ignore your fancier tools
items.title_zh: Grep 取胜 LSP？为何编码代理忽略你更花哨的工具
items.summary_en: A provocative take argues that grep-like search outperforms heavy LSP tooling in coding agents, due to speed and reliability. It outlines why agents default to fast offline indexing and how to design better tooling that complements semantic intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为在编码代理中，grep 这类搜索工具往往比大量的 LSP 工具更快更可靠。文中解释原因，并提出让代理工具结合离线索引与语义能力的设计方向。

items.title_en: Any Human Ever – One life, drawn at random from all who have ever lived
items.title_zh: Any Human Ever：从有史以来所有人生中随机抽取一个
items.summary_en: Any Human Ever randomly selects a life from all humans who have ever lived, presenting a concise biography and statistics. The project invites reflection on population scale, lifespans, and what constitutes being a sample of humanity.
items.summary_zh: Any Human Ever 随机抽取有史以来的一个人生，展示简短传记与统计数据。该项目引发关于人口规模、寿命以及何谓“人类样本”的思考。

items.title_en: A mysterious kidney disease has arrived in Texas
items.title_zh: 德州出现神秘肾病
items.summary_en: Texas sees a new, puzzling kidney disease, prompting epidemiologists to examine environmental, occupational, and socioeconomic links.
items.summary_zh: 德州出现一种新的、令人费解的肾病，促使流行病学家考察环境、职业与社会经济因素之间的联系。报道还讨论监测、医疗获取与移民群体对识别与应对的影响。

items.title_en: Which tools do Claude, Codex and Cursor choose? We measured 17k runs to find out
items.title_zh: Claude、Codex 与 Cursor 选用哪些工具？我们测了 1.7 万次运行来找答案
items.summary_en: Researchers logged 17,000 runs across Claude, Codex, and Cursor to map which tools the agents actually choose when tackling coding tasks. The results highlight which tool types are favored, how tool availability steers behavior, and what this implies for designing robust autonomous assistants.
items.summary_zh: 研究对 Claude、Codex 与 Cursor 的 1.7 万次运行进行了跟踪，揭示这三种编码代理在常见任务中偏向选择的工具类型。结果显示了最常用的工具类别以及工具可用性如何塑造行为，为设计更稳健的自主代理提供洞见。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Why were OpenAI, Claude, and Grok simultaneously down?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：为什么 OpenAI、Claude 与 Grok 同时宕机？巧合吗？
items.summary_en: A thread notes multiple AI services are offline at once, suggesting common infrastructure issues or aligned maintenance windows. The discussion covers resilience strategies, fallback options, and the impact on developers relying on AI APIs.
items.summary_zh: 多家 AI 服务同时宕机引发讨论，可能与共同的基础设施问题或同步维护窗口有关。话题探讨了容错策略、回退方案，以及对依赖 AI API 的开发者的影响。

items.title_en: Project Xanadu: Even More Hindsight
items.title_zh: Xanadu 项目：更深的回顾
items.summary_en: The piece revisits Xanadu's core ideas—transclusion, bidirectional links, and robust versioning—and explains why they were ahead of their time, yet impractical to deploy at scale. It also draws lessons for today's web, such as provenance, offline-first architecture, and data integrity against link rot.
items.summary_zh: 本文回溯 Xanadu 的核心理念——可转引/跨引用、双向链接和强版本控制——并解释为何这些想法虽领先时代、却难以在大规模落地。它还从中提炼出对当今网络的启示，如溯源、离线优先的架构，以及防止链接失效的数据完整性。

items.title_en: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on ARC-AGI-3
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 在 ARC-AGI-3 上
items.summary_en: GPT-6 Astra is being explored within the ARC-AGI-3 ecosystem, hinting at cross-platform experimentation and benchmarking opportunities. The collaboration backdrop could inform how Astra performs across different runtimes and safety frameworks. Expect discussions around interoperability and comparative metrics.
items.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 正在 ARC-AGI-3 生态系统内进行探索，暗示跨平台的实验与基准测试机会。此类协作背景或将揭示 Astra 在不同运行环境与安全框架下的表现差异，读者可关注互操作性与对比指标的讨论。

items.title_en: K2 Horizon: A connected fleet of six open models
items.title_zh: K2 Horizon：六个开源模型组成的互联舰队
items.summary_en: K2 Horizon describes a coordinated suite of six open models designed to work together as a fleet. By sharing tools, contexts, and planning capabilities, they aim to emulate collaborative AI workflows and increase robustness. For the open-model ecosystem, Horizon showcases a path toward more modular, interoperable AI agents.
items.summary_zh: K2 Horizon 描绘了一组协同工作的六个开源模型组成的舰队，通过共享工具、上下文与规划能力，模拟协作式的 AI 工作流并提高鲁棒性。对开源模型生态而言，Horizon 展示了向更模块化、互操作的 AI 代理发展的路径。

items.title_en: OpenAI begins rolling out GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: OpenAI 开始分阶段推出 GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_en: OpenAI begins phased rollout of GPT-6 Astra, signaling broader availability and potential early adopter use cases. Early feedback may shape performance expectations, safety reviews, and integration patterns for developers.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 开始分阶段推出 GPT-6 Astra，标志着更广泛的可用性以及早期采用场景。初期反馈可能影响对性能、安全评审与开发者集成模式的预期。

items.title_en: GLP-1s are being linked to fewer serious infections, including TB
items.title_zh: GLP-1 药物被关联于减少严重感染（包括结核）
items.summary_en: Observational data suggest GLP-1 medications may be associated with a lower risk of serious infections, including TB. While not proving causation, the finding spurs interest in potential immune-modulating effects and calls for focused clinical studies.
items.summary_zh: 观察性数据表明 GLP-1 药物可能与严重感染风险下降相关，包括结核病。虽无法证明因果关系，但这一发现促使研究其潜在的免疫调节作用，并需要进一步的临床研究来证实。

items.title_en: Artificial beaver dams saw juvenile coho salmon survival rates go from 8% to 60%
items.title_zh: 人工海狸坝提升鲑鱼幼鱼存活率
items.summary_en: A study shows artificial beaver dams increased juvenile coho salmon survival from 8% to 60%, illustrating ecosystem engineering benefits. The result highlights how landscape interventions can boost biodiversity and fisheries.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示人工海狸坝将幼年鲑鱼存活率从 8% 提升到 60%，显示出生态工程的潜在效益。结果凸显景观干预对提升生物多样性与渔业的潜在贡献。

items.title_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 发布
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's latest iteration in the Gemini family, promising faster inference and smoother real-time interactions. The update aims to empower more responsive AI applications and better developer tooling, reinforcing Google's push to compete with other high-end LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 是谷歌 Gemini 系列的最新版本，承诺提升推理速度与实时交互的流畅度。该更新旨在为更快速的 AI 应用和更完善的开发工具提供支持，凸显谷歌在高端大模型领域的竞争策略。

items.title_en: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly
items.title_zh: 将 1993 年的 Amiga 游戏移植到 Godot，让 LLM 阅读 68000 汇编
items.summary_en: The author ports a 1993 Amiga game to Godot using an LLM to decipher 68000 assembly. It demonstrates practical AI-assisted reverse engineering and modernization of classic games. The experiment reveals both limitations and potential of LLMs as copilots in software porting tasks.
items.summary_zh: 作者尝试用 LLM 读取 68000 汇编，将 1993 年的 Amiga 游戏移植到 Godot。这一尝试展示了 AI 辅助逆向工程与经典游戏现代化的可行性，同时也揭示了 LLM 作为代码移植助手的局限性与潜力。

items.title_en: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face
items.title_zh: 英伟达将收购 Hugging Face
items.summary_en: NVIDIA announced it will acquire Hugging Face, pairing GPU-accelerated AI hardware with model hosting and tooling in one ecosystem. The deal could reshape how developers train, deploy, and optimize models, with implications for open-source influence and AI infrastructure competition.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达宣布将收购 Hugging Face，意在将硬件加速与模型托管/工具链整合到同一生态。此举可能改变开发者训练、部署和优化模型的方式，并对开源生态和 AI 基础设施竞争格局产生深远影响。

items.title_en: The asteroid currently hitting front end web development
items.title_zh: 当前冲击前端开发的彗星
items.summary_en: A metaphor-laden piece argues front-end tooling and architecture are facing a disruptive period. It highlights debates over frameworks, CSS, tooling complexity, and performance concerns shaping the next era of frontend.
items.summary_zh: 这篇隐喻性文章将前端开发的工具链与架构描述为正处在颠覆性时期，聚焦框架选择、CSS、工具复杂性和性能议题对前端新时代的影响。

items.title_en: Pre-Release of Polars 2.0
items.title_zh: Polars 2.0 预发布
items.summary_en: Polars 2.0 is entering a pre-release phase, signaling a major upgrade for the popular Rust-based data frame library. The release promises performance improvements, new APIs, and potential breaking changes, inviting developers to test early and plan migrations.
items.summary_zh: Polars 2.0 已进入预发布阶段，标志着这款流行的基于 Rust 的数据框架将迎来重大升级。此次更新承诺提升性能、引入新 API，并可能带来破坏性变更，邀请开发者提前测试并规划迁移。

items.title_en: Google Antigravity TOS: 3rd party usage can get Google account suspended
items.title_zh: Google Antigravity 服务条款：第三方使用可能导致账号暂停
items.summary_en: A Terms of Service note warns that using third-party tools to interact with Google services can result in account suspension. The note highlights the tensions between automation, API usage, and platform policies.
items.summary_zh: 服务条款警示，利用第三方工具与 Google 服务交互可能导致账号暂停。此事凸显自动化、API 使用与平台政策之间的博弈。

items.title_en: Muse Spark 1.3
items.title_zh: Muse Spark 1.3
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 release brings improvements in efficiency and safety at scale, with updated tooling for developers and better inference performance. The update signals Meta's continued push to provide accessible AI tools for both on-device and cloud workflows.
items.summary_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.3，提升在大规模部署中的效率与安全性，并带来改进的开发者工具与推理性能。此次更新体现了 Meta 持续推动为开发者提供更易用的 AI 工具，覆盖云端与本地工作流。

items.title_en: How concerned should we be about Astra's recurrent architecture?
items.title_zh: 我们该多担心 Astra 的循环式架构吗？
items.summary_en: The discussion weighs concerns about Astra's recurrent design, including memory retention, stability, and potential toxicity of long context. It frames trade-offs between improved reasoning and risk of hallucination or inefficiency.
items.summary_zh: 讨论评估 Astra 的循环式架构可能带来的记忆保持、稳定性和长上下文潜在的风险。权衡点在于提升推理能力与避免幻觉、低效之间的取舍。

items.title_en: Grok outage
items.title_zh: Grok 服务宕机
items.summary_en: Grok is experiencing an outage, with affected features and timelines posted on the status page. The disruption impacts users relying on real-time AI capabilities.
items.summary_zh: Grok 服务宕机，状态页显示受影响的功能与持续时间，影响依赖实时 AI 功能的用户。

items.title_en: New York Times and The Athletic workers demand company scrap Kalshi deal
items.title_zh: 纽约时报与 The Athletic 员工要求公司取消 Kalshi 交易
items.summary_en: News Guild members urge NYT to scrap the Kalshi deal, citing concerns about newsroom independence and conflicts of interest. They demand transparent terms and assurance that business arrangements won’t influence reporting.
items.summary_zh: 工会成员敦促纽约时报取消 Kalshi 交易，担心新闻独立性和利益冲突。要求交易条款透明，并确保商业安排不会左右报道。

items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5.1
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, minor updates to its Claude family. The changes focus on safety, reliability, and improved tool-using capabilities in chat and coding workflows, which may influence how developers integrate Claude into apps. Users should test for behavior changes, prompt handling tweaks, and any impacts on latency or pricing.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5.1，强调安全性、可靠性和改进的工具使用能力。此举可能影响开发者在构建基于 Claude 的应用时的提示设计、令牌消耗与延迟。请尽早评估新版本的行为变化。

items.title_en: A note on subscription prices from LWN
items.title_zh: 关于 LWN 订阅价格的一些说明
items.summary_en: LWN addresses pricing strategy for subscriptions, possibly changes, value, and tiers; implications for readers who rely on high-quality open-source journalism.
items.summary_zh: LWN 对订阅价格进行了说明，讨论了定价策略、价值与分层等问题，并影响依赖其高质量开源新闻的读者。

items.title_en: Sony makes bold claim about game ownership
items.title_zh: 索尼就数字游戏所有权提出大胆主张
items.summary_en: Sony asserts that players truly own digital games, beyond mere licenses, challenging platform models. The stance could affect resale, portability, and licensing dynamics across PlayStation ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 索尼声称玩家对数字游戏拥有真正的所有权，而不仅仅是使用许可，这一立场可能改变二手交易、跨平台转移和 PSN 体系的许可模式。

items.title_en: From Hookswitch to Grave
items.title_zh: 从 Hookswitch 到 Grave：钩子生命周期的演进
items.summary_en: A reflective note on how software hooks evolve from early integration points toward obsolescence, illustrating lifecycle, maintenance debt, and the challenge of attracting long-term support.
items.summary_zh: 一篇反思性笔记，探讨软件钩子从早期集成点演变到被弃用的过程，揭示生命周期、维护债务与长期支持的挑战。

items.title_en: 120 days until Google restricts side-loading, declaring war on Android freedom
items.title_zh: 距 Google 限制侧载还有 120 天：对 Android 自由的挑战
items.summary_en: Google’s upcoming side-loading restrictions threaten sideloaded apps ecosystem and user choice on Android.
items.summary_zh: Google 即将实施的侧载限制将威胁 Android 生态与用户选择。文章讨论可能的变通方法、安全隐患，以及围绕平台控制权的更广泛辩论。

items.title_en: Google avoids a breakup of its ad tech business
items.title_zh: 谷歌避免分拆其广告技术业务
items.summary_en: Google has avoided a forced breakup of its ad tech business through regulatory remedies, preserving its integrated ad tech stack. The decision shapes competition in online advertising and signals how regulators approach platform ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌通过监管性方案维持广告技术业务的整合结构，避免被拆分。这一走向影响在线广告的竞争格局，也反映监管机构在平台生态上的取舍。

items.title_en: Go grandmaster Shin defeats AI KataGo with a two-stone handicap
items.title_zh: 围棋大师 Shin 在让两子下败 AI KataGo
items.summary_en: A Go match shows a human grandmaster overcome AI KataGo when giving AI a two-stone handicap. The result reinforces that human intuition and strategic depth still matter in AI-assisted games.
items.summary_zh: 在围棋对局中，围棋大师 Shin 在对 KataGo 给出两子让子的情况下获胜。这一结果强化了在 AI 辅助的棋局中，人工直觉与策略深度仍具决定性作用。

items.title_en: Three sites made 215,128 “best software” pages for AI. Perplexity cites them
items.title_zh: 三家站点为 AI 制作了 215,128 个“最佳软件”页面，Perplexity 引用它们
items.summary_en: Three sites collectively produced 215,128 pages labeled 'best software' used by AI systems, according to a Trellner report cited by Perplexity. The finding raises concerns about data provenance, the quality of training sources, and how such manufactured sources may shape AI recommendations.
items.summary_zh: 三家站点合计制作了 215,128 个标注为“最佳软件”的页面，被 AI 系统使用，据 Trellner 的报告被 Perplexity 引用。此发现引发对数据来源、训练源质量的担忧，以及制造性来源如何影响 AI 推荐的可能性。

items.title_en: Can I opt out of my input or output data being used for training?
items.title_zh: 我可以选择不让我的输入或输出数据被用于训练吗？
items.summary_en: The article explains whether you can opt out of having your inputs or model outputs used to train AI systems, and how to exercise privacy controls with mistral.ai.
items.summary_zh: 本文解释是否可选择将自己的输入或输出数据用于训练，以及如何在 mistral.ai 的平台上行使隐私控制和数据偏好。

items.title_en: Fable 5.1 World Modeling
items.title_zh: Fable 5.1 的世界建模
items.summary_en: Fable 5.1 introduces world modeling capabilities, enabling agents to build internal representations of their environments and simulate outcomes for planning. It highlights modular 'worlds' that support scalable reasoning and generalization across tasks. For developers, this signals a shift toward more sample-efficient, model-based approaches in interactive AI systems.
items.summary_zh: Fable 5.1 引入世界建模能力，使代理能够构建环境的内部表示并对结果进行仿真以便规划。它强调支持跨任务的可扩展推理与通用化的模块化“世界”概念。对开发者而言，标志着向更高效、基于模型的交互式 AI 系统迈进。

items.title_en: Gloria Steinem has died
items.title_zh: 格洛丽亚·斯坦姆去世
items.summary_en: Gloria Steinem, a pivotal feminist organizer and writer, has died at age 92. Her career helped advance women's rights and media literacy in tech and beyond, influencing voices in advocacy and policy.
items.summary_zh: 格洛丽亚·斯坦姆，关键的女性主义组织者与作家，逝世，享年92岁。她一生推动女性权利与媒介素养，在科技及其他领域的倡导与政策领域都产生深远影响。

items.title_en: Three schoolgirls in Kinsale pulled up a pea plant covered in warts (2014)
items.title_zh: 肯塞尔三名女学生发现长疣的豌豆苗（2016）
items.summary_en: Three schoolgirls in Kinsale pulled up a pea plant covered in warts and turned the find into a long-running home science project. Over three years they tested about 13,000 seeds in a spare bedroom, with the wart-associated bacteria guiding their barley experiments.
items.summary_zh: 肯塞尔的三名女学生在发现一株长疣的豌豆苗后没放弃，展开了一场持续多年的家庭科学实验。三年间她们在一间空房中试验约1.3万粒种子，豌豆疣中的细菌成为大麦研究的线索。

items.title_en: VC isn't VC anymore
items.title_zh: VC 早已不再是风险投资
items.summary_en: A critique argues that traditional VC is diverging from founder needs, driven by burn rates, fund structure, and market dynamics. The piece calls for rethinking incentives and funding models to support long-horizon innovation.
items.summary_zh: 一篇观点文章认为传统风险投资正在背离创始人需求，受烧钱速度、基金结构和市场动态的驱动。文章呼吁重新设定激励与资助模式，以支持长期创新。

items.title_en: Astronomers Detect a 10-Sided Structure in Saturn's Atmosphere
items.title_zh: 天文学家在土星大气中发现十边形结构
items.summary_en: Astronomers have detected a ten-sided polygonal structure in Saturn's atmosphere, adding a new geometric curiosity beyond Saturn's famous hexagon. The finding prompts questions about atmospheric dynamics on gas giants.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家在土星大气中发现一个十边形结构，增添了继北极六边形之外的新几何现象。此发现引发关于气体巨行星大气动力学的问题。

items.title_en: I wanna live an NPC life
items.title_zh: 我想过NPC 生活
items.summary_en: Explores the appeal of living as an NPC in a world of AI and hyperconnectivity, using the term as a metaphor for autonomy and authenticity. It discusses boundaries between human agency and automated systems.
items.summary_zh: 以“NPC 生活”为喻，探讨在 AI 与高度互联的时代，追求简约、可预设生活的吸引力与边界。文章反思人类自主性与自动化系统之间的关系。

items.title_en: Biggest dark matter detector spots a single weird particle
items.title_zh: 全球最大暗物质探测器观测到一个异常粒子
items.summary_en: A flagship dark matter detector recorded an unusual event that could be either a background glitch or a hint of new physics. The finding underscores the need for careful cross-checks, calibration, and independent verification before claiming discoveries.
items.summary_zh: 一台世界最大规模的暗物质探测器记录到一次异常事件，可能是背景噪声，也可能暗示新物理。此类发现需要严格的复核、标定与独立验证才能成为可靠的物理信号。

items.title_en: VC isn't VC anymore – understanding the rise of Cancer Capital
items.title_zh: VC 不再是 VC？解读‘癌症资本’的崛起
items.summary_en: The piece argues that venture capital has morphed into 'Cancer Capital'—funding practices that emphasize aggressive scaling and short-term gains at the expense of sustainable growth. It analyzes effects on founders, employees, and investors.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为风险投资已演变为“癌症资本”，强调极端扩张与短期回报，牺牲了可持续增长。分析了对创始人、员工与投资人的影响。

items.title_en: Aging brains blend memories together instead of just forgetting them
items.title_zh: 衰老大脑把记忆混合在一起，而非单纯遗忘
items.summary_en: New research suggests aging brains may blend memories across events, reshaping how we recall the past. Implications include misremembering and potential parallels for AI memory models.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示年迈大脑可能把不同事件的记忆混在一起，影响回忆。对记忆机制的理解、以及与 AI 记忆模型的比喻都具有启发性。

items.title_en: Prime Gaps at Most 186
items.title_zh: 至多 186 的素数间隔
items.summary_en: PrimeGaps186 presents a benchmark or dataset exploring prime gaps up to 186, illustrating tooling for number theory experiments. The project hints at new ways to visualize primes and could interest researchers building math-oriented AI capabilities.
items.summary_zh: PrimeGaps186 提供一个探索至多 186 的素数间隔的基准或数据集，展示了用于数论实验的工具。该项目可能为素数可视化提供新思路，并吸引致力于数学相关 AI 能力的研究者。

items.title_en: Commodore 64 released September 1, 1982
items.title_zh: Commodore 64 于1982年9月1日发布
items.summary_en: The Commodore 64, released in 1982, became one of the best-selling home computers due to its balance of price, performance, and a robust software library. Its 64KB RAM, built-in sound, and broad ecosystem helped popularize gaming and home computing, shaping the era’s tech culture.
items.summary_zh: Commodore 64于1982年发布，以性价比、性能与丰富的软件生态著称，成为最畅销的家用电脑之一。64K内存、出众的声音特性和庞大的软件生态推动了游戏与家庭计算的普及，深刻影响了80年代的科技文化。

items.title_en: Exit the Cave
items.title_zh: 走出洞穴
items.summary_en: Step out of the cave: shift from insular rhetoric to evidence-based understanding of technology.
items.summary_zh: 走出洞穴：从闭塞叙事转向以证据为基础的技术理解。

items.title_en: GPS glitched across the US by as much as 33 feet
items.title_zh: GPS 在美国范围内误差高达 33 英尺
items.summary_en: A widespread GPS anomaly caused shifts up to 33 feet across the US, highlighting vulnerabilities in satellite timing. The incident underscores how small navigational errors can cascade into transport, logistics, and safety risk, and prompts discussion of alternative timing sources.
items.summary_zh: 一次广泛的 GPS 异常在美国造成高达 33 英尺的偏移，暴露了卫星定时的脆弱性。此事凸显了微小导航误差如何在运输、物流和安全方面产生连锁影响，并推动对替代时序源的讨论。

items.title_en: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
items.title_zh: FBI 调查销售超过1.53亿张驾照的服务
items.summary_en: The FBI probes a service suspected of selling more than 153 million driver’s licenses, illustrating how ID data marketplaces can operate at scale. The case underscores the urgency of improving credential security and monitoring online marketplaces for illicit activity.
items.summary_zh: FBI 正在调查一家疑似销售超过1.53亿张驾照的服务，揭示了身份数据市场如何在大规模运作。此案凸显提升凭证安全和监控在线非法市场的紧迫性。

items.title_en: Qantas Airbus A380 engine failure in 2010 (2023)
items.title_zh: 2010 年 Qantas A380 发动机故障（2023 年回顾）
items.summary_en: This retrospective revisits a 2010 engine failure on a Qantas A380, examining root causes, maintenance practices, and lessons for airline safety and regulatory oversight. It connects historical incidents to modern reliability expectations for large turbofan engines.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 2010 年 Qantas A380 的发动机故障，分析根本原因、维护实践与对航空安全及监管的启示。将历史事件与对大型涡扇发动机的可靠性期望联系起来，并强调微小公差与检修制度在大规模运营中的重要性。

items.title_en: The browser's main thread is expensive
items.title_zh: 浏览器主线程成本高
items.summary_en: The main thread handles all UI and script work, so heavy tasks directly impact page responsiveness and frame rate.
items.summary_zh: 浏览器的主线程承担着 UI 与脚本的所有工作，密集计算会直接拖慢页面响应和帧率。文章提出减少主线程负担的策略，如将工作移到 Web Worker、批量更新以及使用异步 API和现代任务调度，以保持界面流畅。

items.title_en: My local model setup on an M4 Pro Mac Mini
items.title_zh: 在 M4 Pro Mac Mini 上的本地模型部署
items.summary_en: The post details a practical guide to running local LLM inference on an M4 Pro Mac Mini, including setup, tooling (ggml/llama.cpp or MPS), and performance notes. It demonstrates that privacy-preserving local inference on consumer hardware is increasingly viable for developers and researchers.
items.summary_zh: 该文提供在 M4 Pro Mac Mini 上本地运行大模型推理的实用指南，涵盖环境搭建、工具链（如 ggml/llama.cpp 和 MPS）以及性能要点。表明在消费级硬件上本地推理越来越具可行性，有助于开发者和研究者保护隐私。

items.title_en: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.title_zh: RonanRX（YC S26）——个性化肽类与 GLP-1 药物
items.summary_en: A YC-backed startup, RonanRX, focuses on personalized peptide therapies and GLP-1 treatments, signaling a move toward tailored biotech solutions and raising questions about safety and regulation.
items.summary_zh: 由 YC 支持的 RonanRX 专注于个性化肽类疗法和 GLP-1 药物，标志着生物技术定制化的趋势，同时也引发安全性与监管方面的关注。

items.title_en: Poisson Disk Sampling
items.title_zh: 泊松盘采样
items.summary_en: Explains Poisson disk sampling as a method to generate evenly distributed points without clustering, useful for graphics, spatial sampling, and ML visualization. Includes intuition and practical tips.
items.summary_zh: 介绍泊松盘采样，生成均匀、无聚簇的点分布，广泛用于图形、空间采样和可视化。给出直观解释与实用建议。

items.title_en: Six curl CVEs after OpenAI and Anthropic came back with zero
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Anthropic 回应零漏洞后，curl 仍出现六个 CVE
items.summary_en: Security researchers found six CVEs in curl after major AI companies reported zero vulnerabilities. Highlights ongoing need for proactive auditing, patch cycles, and supply-chain security in ubiquitous tooling.
items.summary_zh: 在两家 AI 巨头报告零漏洞后，curl 仍披露六个 CVE，强调对广泛使用工具持续进行主动审计、补丁更新和供应链安全的重要性。

items.title_en: Quasar 438B: Europe's Leading AI Model
items.title_zh: Quasar 438B：欧洲领先的 AI 模型
items.summary_en: Introduces Quasar 438B as a leading European AI model, outlining architecture, capabilities, and strategic significance for EU AI sovereignty and research collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Quasar 438B 这一欧洲领先的 AI 模型，概述架构、能力及对欧盟 AI 主权与科研协作的意义。

items.title_en: Unusual Suspects
items.title_zh: 不寻常的嫌疑人
items.summary_en: Unusual Suspects is an interactive project that invites curiosity through unconventional prompts.
items.summary_zh: Unusual Suspects 是一个互动项目，通过非传统提示引发好奇心。

items.title_en: Reasons robotics is hard
items.title_zh: 机器人为何难以实现：十四条原因
items.summary_en: A concise list of 14 fundamental challenges in robotics, from perception and control to system integration, safety, and real-world deployment hurdles.
items.summary_zh: 总结了机器人领域的14个核心难点，涵盖感知、控制、系统集成、安全性以及落地部署等方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who is using MCP in production?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁在生产环境中使用 MCP？
items.summary_en: The thread collects real-world experiences with MCP in production, including performance, reliability, and integration challenges. Participants compare MCP usage to alternative approaches and discuss tradeoffs.
items.summary_zh: 讨论收集了在生产环境中使用 MCP 的真实经验，包括性能、可靠性和集成挑战，并对比了替代方案与权衡。

items.title_en: The largest electric aircraft just flew [video]
items.title_zh: 全球最大电动飞机刚完成飞行（视频）
items.summary_en: The video showcases the largest electric aircraft taking flight, marking progress in electric propulsion and aviation design. Such demonstrations help validate battery energy density, cooling, and safety systems at scale, with implications for urban air mobility and cargo. Industry watchers will be watching for performance metrics and real-world range implications.
items.summary_zh: 视频展示了全球最大的电动飞机完成飞行，标志着电动推进与航空设计的进展。这类示范有助于验证大规模电池能量密度、散热与安全系统，并影响城市空运与货运应用。行业关注点在于性能指标与实际续航的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Claude for Commerce Agents
items.title_zh: Claude 面向商务代理的能力升级
items.summary_en: Claude gains new capabilities tailored for commerce agents, enabling faster customer interactions, order processing, and sales workflows. The update expands Claude’s role in e-commerce, with attention to privacy and data handling.
items.summary_zh: Claude 推出面向商务代理的新能力，加速客户沟通、订单处理与销售流程的自动化。此更新扩大了 Claude 在电商场景中的应用，同时关注隐私与数据处理。

items.title_en: Texas Data Center Map: See where data centers are operating or planned
items.title_zh: 德州数据中心地图：查看现有与规划中的数据中心
items.summary_en: An interactive map shows Texas data centers operating or planned, highlighting regional concentration and growth in cloud infrastructure. The tracker helps gauge energy demand and regional capacity.
items.summary_zh: 一张交互地图显示德州现有与规划中的数据中心，突出区域集中度与云基础设施增长。该追踪有助于评估能源需求与区域容量。

items.title_en: Static Allocation, Constant Work
items.title_zh: 静态分配与恒定工作量
items.summary_en: A technical look at static allocation and constant work, arguing that fixed resource planning can yield predictable latency and simpler reasoning for systems programmers. Practical guidance helps choose when preallocation pays off.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨静态分配与恒定工作量，认为固定资源规划能带来可预测的延迟与更易推理的代码。为系统程序员在何时应优先预分配提供实用建议。

items.title_en: Japan halves speed limit to 30km/h on all narrow city streets
items.title_zh: 日本在所有狭窄市区街道统一限速至30公里/小时
items.summary_en: Japan is cutting the speed limit to 30 km/h on all narrow city streets to improve pedestrian safety and overall urban livability. The move aligns with global trends toward slower, safer streets and could impact travel times, enforcement, and urban design.
items.summary_zh: 日本将狭窄市区街道的限速统一降至每小时30公里，以提升行人安全和城市宜居性。这一举措与全球推动更慢更安全街区的趋势相契合，可能影响通勤时间、执法方式以及城市设计。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Mireye (YC S26) – Infrastructure for Physical World AI Agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Mireye（YC S26）——面向现实世界 AI 代理的基础设施
items.summary_en: Mireye provides infrastructure for deploying AI agents in the physical world, including robotics and sensor integration. The YC S26 startup promises tools to coordinate perception, planning, and actuation at scale.
items.summary_zh: Mireye 提供面向现实世界的 AI 代理部署基础设施，涵盖机器人感知、规划与执行的整合。该 YC S26 初创公司承诺实现大规模的感知、决策与行动编排。

items.title_en: Fine, I'll build my own text editor
items.title_zh: 好吧，我自己动手打造文本编辑器
items.summary_en: The post chronicles building a personal text editor from scratch to explore editor architecture, including buffers, syntax highlighting, and extensibility.
items.summary_zh: 博主分享从零开始构建个人文本编辑器的过程，聚焦缓冲区、语法高亮和可扩展性等编辑器架构要点。

items.title_en: WebLLM: high-performance in-browser LLM inference engine
items.title_zh: WebLLM：高性能浏览器端 LLM 推理引擎
items.summary_en: A browser-based LLM inference engine that runs locally in the client, enabling private, low-latency prompts without sending data to servers. Discusses architecture, WASM, and performance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 基于浏览器的本地 LLM 推理引擎，支持在客户端私有、低延迟的输入输出，不必将数据送回服务器。介绍架构、WASM 实现及性能权衡。

items.title_en: Async Rust vs RTOS showdown (2022)
items.title_zh: Async Rust 与 RTOS 的对决（2022）
items.summary_en: A detailed comparison of asynchronous Rust versus RTOS for embedded systems, highlighting latency, determinism, memory safety, and ecosystem trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 对嵌入式系统中异步 Rust 与 RTOS 的深入对比，聚焦延迟、确定性、内存安全和生态系统的取舍。

items.title_en: Unified Arabic
items.title_zh: 统一的阿拉伯语
items.summary_en: Unified Arabic discusses standardization efforts or a project aiming to unify dialects or encoding. If successful, it could simplify cross-dialect NLP and improve tooling for Arabic-speaking communities.
items.summary_zh: 《统一的阿拉伯语》探讨语言标准化努力或统一方言与编码的项目。若取得成效，将简化跨方言的自然语言处理并改善阿拉伯语使用者的工具链。

items.title_en: Wendell Berry has died
items.title_zh: 温德尔·贝瑞逝世
items.summary_en: Renowned poet and environmental writer Wendell Berry died at 94. His work on farming, community, and critiques of modern technology shaped American literature and ecological thought.
items.summary_zh: 著名诗人兼环保作家温德尔·贝瑞去世，享年94岁。他的作品聚焦乡村生活、社区价值，以及对现代技术的批评，对美国家文学与生态思想产生深远影响。

items.title_en: Invisible Companies
items.title_zh: 隐形公司
items.summary_en: Colossus examines 'invisible companies'—organisations essential to tech ecosystems yet largely unseen by the public. The piece analyzes their structures, funding, and influence on innovation.
items.summary_zh: Colossus 探讨在科技生态系统中扮演关键角色却鲜少为公众所知的“隐形公司”，分析其组织结构、融资方式及对创新的影响。

items.title_en: LLMs: Intelligence vs. Cost
items.title_zh: LLMs：智能与成本
items.summary_en: Analyzes trade-offs between model capability, latency, and price; offers patterns for cost-effective deployments including tiered models, caching, and prompt engineering.
items.summary_zh: 分析模型能力、延迟与成本之间的权衡，给出分层模型、缓存和提示优化等成本效益策略。

items.title_en: Altair Basic Interpreter Source Code (1975) [pdf]
items.title_zh: Altair Basic 解释器源代码（1975）[PDF]
items.summary_en: Releasing the original Altair BASIC source code provides a window into early microcomputer software engineering and Microsoft's roots. The document showcases tiny, hand-optimized code and the constraints of 1970s hardware, offering lessons for language design and open-source retrospectives.
items.summary_zh: 公开原始的 Altair BASIC 源代码，为早期微型计算机软件工程与微软起源提供一扇窗。文档展示了极小且经过手工优化的代码，以及 1970 年代硬件条件下的设计取舍，为语言设计与开源史提供珍贵素材。

items.title_en: The Silo · interactive 3D cutaway
items.title_zh: The Silo · 互动3D剖切
items.summary_en: An interactive 3D cutaway showcasing the silo's internal structure and systems, highlighting how modern visualization aids understanding of complex machinery.
items.summary_zh: 一个互动式的3D剖切展示，揭示筒仓内部结构与系统，展示可视化在理解复杂机械中的作用。

items.title_en: The true horror of Edgar Allan Poe’s stories lies in their confessions
items.title_zh: 爱伦·坡故事的真正恐怖在于自白
items.summary_en: A literary critique reframes Poe's horror through the lens of confession and intimate truth rather than gore. By focusing on unreliable narrators and buried self-revelations, the piece reveals psychology as the engine of dread.
items.summary_zh: 一篇文学评论将坡（Poe）恐怖的核心放在人物自白与隐秘的真实之上，而非喧嚣血腥。通过聚焦不可靠叙述者与埋藏的自我揭示，揭示了心理因素如何成为恐怖的驱动力。

items.title_en: Reverse Engineering Unknown File Formats with ImHex
items.title_zh: 使用 ImHex 逆向未知文件格式
items.summary_en: ImHex offers templates and tooling to reverse engineer unknown binary formats. The post demonstrates practical techniques for inferring structure, extracting fields, and automating format recognition, underscoring the value of template-driven analysis in malware and forensics contexts. It also shows how to capture endianess, alignment, and nested blocks.
items.summary_zh: ImHex 提供模板与工具，用于逆向未知二进制格式。文章演示了通过结构推断、字段提取与格式自动识别的实用技巧，强调在恶意软件分析与取证场景中模板驱动分析的价值，还涉及字节序、对齐与嵌套块等要点。

items.title_en: Xanadu was waiting for agents
items.title_zh: Xanadu 正在等待代理
items.summary_en: A treatise or narrative explores agentic AI—autonomous agents—waiting to be unleashed in a Xanadu-like network.
items.summary_zh: 一篇论述探讨具自主性的 AI 代理在类似 Xanadu 的网络中待发的情景，考察代理如何协同、治理以及对人类监管的挑战。

items.title_en: New type of dice guarantees no tie when deciding who goes first
items.title_zh: 新型骰子确保先手决议不打平
items.summary_en: A new dice design promises unique outcomes without ties when choosing who goes first, potentially changing how casual games and competitive setups handle randomness. The design uses weighted faces or clever geometry to ensure a decisive result.
items.summary_zh: 一种新型骰子设计承诺在决定先手时避免平局，可能改变休闲游戏和竞赛中对随机性的处理。设计通过加权面或巧妙的几何结构确保结果定夺。

items.title_en: Holden's Lightning Flight
items.title_zh: 霍尔登的闪电飞行
items.summary_en: A historical account of Holden's bold high-speed flight, illustrating the daring of early aviation and the risks of pioneering experiments. It covers the aircraft design, weather conditions, and the era's scientific curiosity.
items.summary_zh: 讲述霍尔登进行高速飞行的历史事件，展示早期航空探索的勇气与冒险。文中回顾相关的飞机设计、天气因素及当时的科技热情。

items.title_en: A Selection of Los Alamos Rolodex Business Cards
items.title_zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯 Rolodex 名片精选
items.summary_en: A curated glimpse into scientists’ networks from Los Alamos through historical business cards; reveals collaboration webs, institutional culture, and design of professional cards from the era.
items.summary_zh: 通过历史名片展现洛斯阿拉莫斯科学家之间的网络与合作文化，提供对当时专业名片设计与机构氛围的珍贵一瞥。

items.title_en: We could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
items.title_zh: 用 Zstandard 与 Pingora 节省缓存存储量
items.summary_en: Cloudflare describes how combining Zstandard compression with Pingora caching can drastically reduce cache storage and bandwidth for serving content.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 说明将 Zstandard 压缩与 Pingora 缓存结合使用，可以显著降低缓存存储需求和带宽成本，提升缓存系统效率。

items.title_en: How to get a free .arpa domain
items.title_zh: 如何获得免费 .arpa 域名
items.summary_en: A quirky guide explains how to obtain a free ARPA domain, touching on DNS history and legacy infrastructure. The piece uses the quirk to spark discussion about internet governance and naming systems.
items.summary_zh: 一篇古怪的指南讲述如何获得免费 ARPA 域名，涉及 DNS 历史与遗留基础设施。通过这个趣题引发对互联网治理与命名系统的讨论。

items.title_en: Engineering of the fastest WebAssembly interpreters
items.title_zh: 最快的 WebAssembly 解释器的工程实现
items.summary_en: A design-focused look at Wasmi v2.0 and the engineering choices behind a high-performance WASM interpreter. It covers optimizations, memory model handling, and architecture decisions enabling speed at the cost of complexity, with implications for edge runtimes and blockchain smart contracts.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦 Wasmi v2.0 的设计与实现，解读高性能 WASM 解释器背后的工程取舍。内容涵盖优化、内存模型处理及推动边缘运行时与区块链智能合约性能的架构决策及其代价。

items.title_en: Show HN: OwnTime – a chess clock for your day's priorities
items.title_zh: Show HN：OwnTime——为每日优先事项设计的计时棋钟
items.summary_en: OwnTime visualizes daily priorities as time blocks, turning tasks into moves on a clock-like interface. It aims to help users manage focus and daily planning more effectively.
items.summary_zh: OwnTime 将每日优先事项可视化为时间块，将任务转化为类似棋盘的时间移动，帮助用户更高效地管理专注与日程。

items.title_en: LLMs and self-referentiality
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型与自指性
items.summary_en: Scott Aaronson dives into self-referentiality in large language models, examining how models handle self-referential prompts, recursion, and the illusion of self-awareness, with implications for reasoning, reliability, and AI alignment.
items.summary_zh: Scott Aaronson 探讨大型语言模型中的自指性，分析模型如何处理自指提示、递归和自我意识错觉，对推理、可靠性和 AI 对齐有何启示。

items.title_en: Show HN: The cheapest GPU cloud – H100s at $2.04/HR, H200s at $3/HR
items.title_zh: Show HN：最便宜的 GPU 云服务——H100 2.04 美元/小时，H200 3 美元/小时
items.summary_en: A Show HN post highlights a GPU cloud provider offering H100s at $2.04 per hour and H200s at $3 per hour, a striking contrast to mainstream cloud pricing. The cheap price enables more experimentation with ML workloads, though users should vet availability, support, and terms.
items.summary_zh: 这则 Show HN 帖子展示了一家云端 GPU 服务商，H100 每小时仅 2.04 美元，H200 每小时仅 3 美元，与主流云厂商相比价格极具竞争力。低价为机器学习工作负载带来更多试验机会，但需关注可用性、支持和条款等风险。

items.title_en: What I learned from my mom (1941-2026)
items.title_zh: 我从母亲身上学到的教训（1941-2026）
items.summary_en: A personal reflection tracing lessons from the author's mother across decades, touching on resilience, kindness, and practical wisdom. The piece ties maternal influence to modern life, including how technology and curiosity shape everyday choices.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇个人反思，回顾母亲在几十年里教给作者的韧性、善良和务实智慧。文中把母亲的影响与当代生活联系起来，探讨科技与好奇心如何融入日常选择。

items.title_en: Higher Multipoles of the Cow
items.title_zh: 牛的高阶多极矩
items.summary_en: A physics preprint exploring higher multipole contributions in the COW (Colella-Overhauser-Werner) experiment, shedding light on precision tests of gravitational interaction with quantum systems.
items.summary_zh: 一篇物理学预印本，探讨 COW 实验中的高阶多极项，对将引力与量子系统相耦合的精确测试具有意义。

items.title_en: A PCB business card with a batteryless LED, powered by the phone that taps it
items.title_zh: 一张无电池 LED 的 PCB 名片：由手机供能点亮
items.summary_en: A batteryless LED on a PCB business card is powered by the proximity/inductive energy from a phone, enabling a light-up effect without a battery. The idea showcases compact energy harvesting for memorable networking gear, along with tradeoffs in cost, durability, and reliability.
items.summary_zh: 一张带无电池 LED 的 PCB 名片通过手机触碰或靠近时产生的能量点亮，展示了能量收集在网络社交中的应用。该设计强调低功耗、易于实现的能量传输方案及成本与耐用性的权衡。

items.title_en: The shrinking landscape of linguistic diversity in the age of LLMs
items.title_zh: 在大型语言模型时代语言多样性的缩小
items.summary_en: As language models become dominant, many languages lose digital presence and resources, shrinking linguistic diversity.
items.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型的普及，许多语言在数字世界的存在与资源减少，语言多样性正趋于缩小。文章总结了相关证据并呼吁加强政策与研究支持以保护小语种。

items.title_en: Making the Internet Boring
items.title_zh: 让互联网变得无聊
items.summary_en: A provocative essay arguing that making the internet boring could reduce scams, surveillance, and sensationalism, by redesigning incentives and interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章提出通过改变激励和界面设计，让互联网变得“无聊”，从而减少骗局、监控和喧嚣化现象。

items.title_en: The Computer Museum of America reclamation project
items.title_zh: 美国计算机博物馆的回收计划
items.summary_en: The Computer Museum of America is pursuing a reclamation project to salvage and preserve iconic computing artifacts, expanding its collection and improving exhibition spaces.
items.summary_zh: 美国计算机博物馆正在推进一项回收计划，旨在拯救并保存标志性计算机文物，扩展藏品并改善展览空间。

items.title_en: Fish bad, sugar good, and other medieval ideas about food
items.title_zh: 鱼坏糖好，以及其他中世纪饮食观念
items.summary_en: This examination of medieval dietary beliefs shows how ideas about what constitutes healthy eating were shaped by religion, season, and status rather than science. It contrasts with modern nutrition, illustrating how culture and lore influenced what people ate and avoided.
items.summary_zh: 本文梳理中世纪的饮食观念，揭示关于何谓健康饮食的看法往往由宗教、季节与社会地位等因素塑造，而非科学证据。与现代营养观形成对照，史事揭示了文化与传说如何左右人们的饮食选择。

items.title_en: Dextroproporphan: An Analogue for a Better Dextromethorphan?
items.title_zh: Dextroproporphan：一种更安全的 dextromethorphan 类药物
items.summary_en: Dextroproporphan is presented as an analogue designed to improve on dextromethorphan, aiming for safer, more manageable effects. The write-up surveys its pharmacology and potential therapeutic applications while noting early-stage development.
items.summary_zh: 将其视为更安全、潜在更优的 dextromethorphan 类药物，探讨其药理特性与潜在应用方向，同时指出仍处于早期开发阶段。

items.title_en: Intrusive linked lists (2019)
items.title_zh: Intrusive linked lists（2019）
items.summary_en: A technical exploration of intrusive linked lists, where list pointers are embedded in the containing objects themselves, trading safety for performance and control. It covers use cases, memory implications, and common pitfalls.
items.summary_zh: 对侵入式链表的技术探讨——将链表指针嵌入包含对象中，换取性能与控制权，代价是安全性。涵盖应用场景、内存影响与常见坑。

items.title_en: How an MIT research project became the Julia programming language
items.title_zh: MIT 研究项目如何演变成 Julia 编程语言
items.summary_en: MIT researchers helped seed Julia's design to blend Python's ease with C/Fortran-like speed, eventually becoming a community-driven language with multiple dispatch, LLVM-based JIT, and strong numeric computing capabilities. The piece profiles founders, funding, and mentorship shaping Julia's path from university project to language ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述 Julia 如何从 MIT 的研究项目逐步成长为具备多重分发、LLVM JIT、强数值计算能力的通用编程语言，以及在社区驱动下从学术研究走向生产生态的过程。

items.title_en: Working to Make Python Lazy
items.title_zh: 让 Python 懒加载：从实现到工具支持
items.summary_en: Explores practical patterns for lazy evaluation in Python, focusing on deferring imports and computations to speed startup and reduce memory usage. The post also highlights tooling support, like a flake8 plugin, to safely enforce lazy patterns without breaking code.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在 Python 中实现惰性加载的实用模式，重点是推迟导入与计算以提升启动速度和降低内存占用。文中还介绍了工具支持，如 flake8 插件，用于安全地强制实施惰性模式而不破坏现有代码。

items.title_en: “We want it to really confuse people, but also really make people happy”
items.title_zh: “我们想让它真的让人困惑，也真正让人开心”
items.summary_en: A design philosophy centers on creating experiences that provoke curiosity while delivering delight.
items.summary_zh: 一种设计哲学强调在引发好奇的同时带来愉悦体验，探讨在面向用户的产品中平衡模糊感与满足感。

items.title_en: Parque Arqueológico do Solstício
items.title_zh: 亚马逊 Stonehenge：Solstício 考古公园
items.summary_en: Amazon Stonehenge refers to a project or site focused on solstice-related archaeology within the Amazon context, highlighting the intersection of culture, history, and modern interpretation.
items.summary_zh: “亚马逊 Stonehenge” 是一个聚焦于极日与 solstice 相关考古的项目/地点，展示文化与历史在现代语境中的诠释。

items.title_en: Virtual Threads for a scripting language in Java 8 without Loom
items.title_zh: 在不使用 Loom 的 Java 8 中为脚本语言实现虚拟线程
items.summary_en: JACTL demonstrates implementing virtual threads in Java 8 for a scripting language without Loom, using user-space continuations and trampolines to achieve async I/O without requiring newer JVM features.
items.summary_zh: JACTL 展示在不使用 Loom 的 Java 8 环境下，为脚本语言实现虚拟线程，利用用户态连续体和回转实现异步 I/O，而无需更新的 JVM 功能。

items.title_en: A thousand years older than Stonehenge: Archaeologists explore a Czech sanctuary
items.title_zh: 比巨石阵更古老的一千年的捷克圣地
items.summary_en: Archaeologists investigate an ancient Czech sanctuary potentially predating Stonehenge by a millennium. Findings could reshape understanding of European prehistoric religious practices and ritual spaces.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家正在研究一个捷克的古代圣地，或比巨石阵早一千年。新发现可能重新塑造对欧洲史前宗教实践与仪式场所的理解。
